content.text: {"name":"WorldDivideMCP.RTSConsoleToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Runs console commands in the World Divide editor, in the running Play-In-Editor session when there is one.","tools":[{"description":"Runs a console command, e.g. \"stat fps\" or \"rts.UI.Reload\".\nDuring Play-In-Editor it runs on the first local player of the PIE session, so stat overlays show in the\nPIE viewport; otherwise it runs in the editor world.","name":"WorldDivideMCP.RTSConsoleToolset.ExecuteConsoleCommand","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"command":{"type":"string","description":"The console command line to run."}},"required":["command"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"The text the command printed, or a note that it printed nothing. An empty, unknown or refused command raises a script error, which the MCP caller receives as a tool error with the reason."}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
